basics.name: Carlos Miguel
basics.label: Full Stack Web Developer with over 3 years of experience
basics.summary: I am a self-taught developer with over 3 years of independent programming studies and almost 2 years of professional experience working on freelance projects. I have experience developing web applications using modern technologies with a focus on creating functional, efficient, and well-structured solutions. I am a native Spanish speaker with proficiency in English and Portuguese, which facilitates collaboration in multicultural environments. I currently reside in Brazil and am seeking new opportunities to continue evolving professionally and contributing to teams and projects in the web development field.

work.name: Bombero Callejero
work.summary: Refactoring and fixing an educational web platform for firefighters in Spain that offers detailed street maps along with interactive quizzes to assess knowledge through map-based questions, with a focus on professional preparation and training for the fire department. The project, initially developed by someone else, required fixing numerous bugs, working with maps using Leaflet, including creating my own Leaflet plugin to render text on polylines with optimized performance, migrating two Laravel 8 and Laravel 9 servers to Laravel 10, implementing task queuing for better processing, optimizing endpoints, developing the frontend with Vue and TypeScript to create user interfaces, and creating a digital image section with a Canva-style editor using the Konva.js library.

work.name: GotoSend
work.summary: I developed a complete and robust web platform for selling cell phone recharges for Cuba and abroad, as well as for selling gift cards. The project included successful integration of various APIs such as Innoverit and DTOne for automatic recharge processing, as well as implementing the PAYCOMET payment gateway for secure transactions. I used a robust technology stack with PHP for business logic, Node.js and Express for developing custom APIs, MySQL as a relational database, and Bootstrap with jQuery for a responsive and dynamic interface. Additionally, I developed an admin panel for user and recharge management. I implemented cron jobs to automate system processes, achieving more efficient operations and significantly reducing processing times.
